verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any event-driven rules engine that triggers automated actions. Budget alerts (azure-docs-13) and outage notifications are adjacent alerting features, not user-defined rules that run actions. CLI scripting and IaC templates are developer building blocks, not event-triggered automation, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
